about.title: About me
about.paragraph1: I study Software Engineering at Universidad de Santander and expect to graduate in January 2027.
about.paragraph2: I work directly with you to understand what your business needs. I use AI tools to speed up development, and I review, test, and validate each delivery with you step by step.

process.title: How I approach a project
process.subtitle: Clear steps so you know what to expect at each stage.
process.phase1_desc: I learn what you need and what problem you want to solve.
process.phase2_desc: We define what to build, in what order, and the cost by module.
process.phase3_desc: We move forward in parts, and you can review each delivery.
process.phase4_desc: I get the project running and can help after launch.

bullets: Built a system to organize and track landscaping projects
Included user management, material orders, and a calendar
Published the system and provided post-launch support: investigated reports of missing or deleted information, pagination issues, and interface adjustments, found the cause, and fixed them
Built and published the corporate website
Added a form for receiving quote requests by email
Worked directly with the client to define the website content and needs

alonso.name: Project Management System
alonso.problem: The company needed one place to track projects, material orders, and its calendar.
alonso.work: I built a management system tailored to that workflow.
alonso.includes: User accounts and permissions, material orders, and a project calendar.

opmy.name: Corporate Landing Page
opmy.problem: The company needed to present its services online and receive quote requests.
opmy.work: I designed, built, and published a corporate website.

demo.title: Live
demo.subtitle: Some of the capabilities I apply in my projects
demo.responsiveDesc: This same page adapts to mobile, tablet, and desktop.
demo.responsiveTabletHint: On tablet: 2 columns and visible navigation.
demo.responsiveDesktopHint: On desktop: 3 columns and full layout.
demo.responsiveTip: Drag the slider or pick a size to see how the layout changes by width (typical breakpoints: 768px, 1024px).
demo.desktopHeroText: Full layout example with sections, text and images that adapt to the available space.
demo.desktopFeatureDesc: Short description of the service or feature.
demo.desktopAboutText: Sample text for a section. Content reflows by width: on desktop it uses the full space with flexible columns and containers.
demo.blockContent1: Section content. Title and text that adapt to the width.
demo.blockContent2: Short description of services or block features.
demo.blockContent3: Form or contact links. Each block simulates a section.
demo.formsDesc: Real-time validation, clear error messages and success feedback. Focus on UX and accessibility.
demo.formsSuccessText: Thank you. I'll get back to you as soon as possible.
demo.formsTip: Try leaving fields empty or with invalid data to see error messages.
demo.perfDesc: Before: everything loads at once. After: lazy loading for images and deferred section loading.
demo.perfDeferText: This block was only fetched when you requested it (code-splitting / lazy load).
demo.perfCwv: These practices improve LCP, FID and CLS (Core Web Vitals) and Lighthouse scores.
demo.perfTip: Switch to «After» and scroll to see images load as they enter the viewport.
